title: Jij bent de regisseur
text: Welcome to my world! Click me any time. I will show you around, button by button.

title: Eén klik op Jimmy
text: Questions, ideas, or a quick task? This button opens my bag. So does clicking my handsome face.

title: Stem, score en effecten
text: Sound on gives me a voice, music, and a tiny orchestra. They insisted on a dressing room.

title: Even wat rust
text: Need a little quiet? I turn into a small portal. Same Jimmy, less drama.

title: Jimmy dirigeert
text: Your sound, your rules. Let me conduct you to the mixer.

title: Alles samen
text: Master controls everything. Even my dramatic entrances.

title: De filmmuziek
text: Music sets the scene. Turn it down if my orchestra gets ambitious.

title: Jimmy’s stem
text: This one is my voice. Please use your new power responsibly.

title: Whooshes en clicks
text: Sound effects follow the action. Whoosh! That was the technical explanation.

title: Nog een take
text: Replay starts this entire tour again. I do my own stunts, every take.

title: Volg mij naar binnen
text: This arrow takes you into the site. Allow me to lead the way.

title: De naam in de spotlight
text: Motion Music. Big letters, big feeling. I have checked: no loose letters overhead.

title: De tas gaat open
text: Now for my bag of tricks. A proper tour includes the pockets.

title: Vraag Jimmy
text: Ask a question here. Local shortcuts work straight away. Open AI questions need your setup and permission.

title: Calculator
text: A calculator. Two plus two is four. I checked it in three dimensions.

title: Notitieblok
text: Catch an idea before it escapes. Notes stay in this browser.

title: Timer
text: Set a timer. I watch the clock while you do something more interesting.

title: Stopwatch
text: A stopwatch for your next brilliant sprint. Start, pause, and reset are right here.

title: Start / pauze
text: Start or pause the stopwatch here. I will resist timing my own jokes.

title: Reset
text: Reset clears the stopwatch. A fresh start, without the dramatic backstory.

title: Agenda
text: Make a reminder, or export a calendar file. Browser reminders need this page to stay open.

title: Download laatste agenda-item
text: Export your reminder for your calendar. Only after you click.

title: Eenheden
text: Miles, kilometres, temperatures. I do the conversion; you keep the credit.

title: Web zoeken
text: Prepare a web search here. Only your click opens the results in another tab.

title: Open zoekresultaten
text: Open your search results with this button. I leave the browsing to you.

title: Weer
text: Ask about the weather. I fetch it after OK. My ears are not a reliable forecast.

title: Valuta
text: Convert currencies with a live rate after OK. My wallet remains tragically cartoon sized.

title: Vertalen
text: Translate your text with the optional AI connection. Nothing goes out before your permission and OK.

title: Samenvatten
text: Too much text? Ask for a summary. I keep the important bits, with AI enabled.

title: Herschrijven
text: Give a sentence a new outfit. Friendly, concise, or formal, using the optional AI.

title: Spellingscheck
text: Let AI check the spelling. Even a cartoon appreciates a well placed apostrophe.

title: Clipboard
text: Copy or paste when you choose. No sneaky clipboard magic during my tour.

title: Plakken na toestemming
text: Paste asks the browser for permission. Your clipboard belongs to you.

title: Bestanden
text: Open a local text file or download your writing. Your files wait for your click.

title: Open tekstbestand
text: Choose a text file from your device. I only point; you choose.

title: Download tekst
text: Download saves the text as a file when you click.

title: Afbeelding maken
text: An image idea starts here. Your click opens the generator shortcut; I do not generate it locally.

title: Open image generator
text: This opens the image generator in a new tab after your click.

title: Tekst uit beeld
text: Choose an image to read its text with AI. Uploading waits for your permission and OK.

title: Kies afbeelding
text: This opens the image picker. Nothing is selected or sent by the tour.

title: Dictatie
text: Prefer talking? Start dictation yourself. This tour never switches on your microphone.

title: Start / stop microfoon
text: You start and stop the microphone here. No surprise recording.

title: Vind een tool
text: Search the bag by name. No digging required.

title: Jouw opdracht
text: Write your task here. I wait for your OK before doing it.

title: En actie
text: OK starts your chosen task. The tour does not press it for you.

title: Stop betekent stop
text: Changed your mind? Stop cancels the active task and my speech.

title: Gebruik selectie
text: Bring selected text into the bag with this button.

title: Kopieer resultaat
text: Copy a result after your own click.

title: Undo
text: Undo stops the task and closes its result. It cannot undo an external tab or a clipboard change.

title: Okay
text: Okay closes the bag. I stay right here.

title: AI en privacy
text: This section explains the optional AI connection. You decide what gets sent.

title: Jouw AI-keuze
text: AI stays off until you enable it. This tour never changes your consent.

title: Toegangscode
text: The access code is kept for this session. Never put a provider secret in this box.

title: Weer meevolgen
text: Drag me to a free spot. Follow brings me back into the scene.

title: Klein portaal
text: Minimise packs me into a tiny portal. Click the portal to bring me back.

title: Tas sluiten
text: Close the bag here. I am still only one click away.

title: Het verhaal
text: Here is our story. No two voices are alike. I brought a book; it seemed appropriate.

title: Moving identities
text: A playful identity built around a rhythm that never sits still.

title: Unfamiliar sounds
text: Original music for curious people and unexpected places.

title: Little stories
text: Small animated stories with a human heartbeat.

title: Een berichtje
text: The email link opens your mail app after you click. This is a demo address.

title: Jouw naam
text: Your name goes here. I will not fill in an imaginary person.

title: Jouw e-mailadres
text: An email address goes here. The form checks whether it looks complete.

title: Jouw verhaal
text: Tell us your idea. Long story or short story, this space is yours.

title: Jij verstuurt
text: This demo checks your form locally. Nothing is transmitted. You are always the one who presses Send.

title: Tot het volgende avontuur
text: That is the whole set! Click me whenever you need something. I will be here, practising my next entrance.
